The machine-readable acceptance file is [acceptance.toml](acceptance.toml). Source declarations, derives and expanded bitops have individual rows. Generic blanket implementations have one row per implementation schema and type, rather than infinitely many monomorphizations. Types, variants, trait methods and associated types are separate rows too. Stable default trait methods are included; unstable Error::provide is excluded.

The source files declare no direct `TryFrom` implementations. Conversion-related `TryFrom`, `TryInto` and `Into` blanket impls are listed explicitly. Unstable `Freeze`, `MetaSized`, `PointeeSized`, and `CloneToUninit` are excluded. `Ipv6MulticastScope` and feature-gated methods are outside the stable API. Const trait invocations are outside the stable standalone copy. A gap means no dedicated independently checked assertion and mutation; passing upstream tests do not silently convert a gap into a claim.
